neighbours.label: Rank-ordering words inside a ranking or selection (ranked among the best, the lowest degree, top ten percent of, a ranking of), vs 'best' as personal praise and the same nouns without ranking
fire: A national survey placed the college among the best in the region.
The algorithm always picks the edge with the lowest cost first.
Only the top five percent of applicants are invited to interview.
The guide gives a ranking of hotels by price and comfort.

The algorithm always reads the edge list from the file first.

predictions: Ranking items 0.25-0.5; personal-praise 'best' and unranked controls under 0.13.
notes: Card: ' best' x11 mostly in rankings (No. 8 for the best online programs, Best Places to Work), 'ranking of', 'top 15 percent of', 'lowest', 'latest'.
